summary: New Found Gold Corp. filed a Form 6-K attaching an underwriting agreement dated April 22, 2026, for a public offering of 33,800,000 common shares at $2.96 per share, with an over-allotment option for 5,070,000 additional shares, targeting gross proceeds of $100,048,000. The offering is underwritten by BMO Nesbitt Burns Inc. and SCP Resource Finance LP as joint lead underwriters. This is a standard equity capital raise, not a special situation. There are no deal terms indicating an acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special event. The filing is a routine follow-on offering, thus not classifiable as a special situation.
